remarks: City living in the treetops! Located on the brim of vibrant & sophisticated downtown Stamford, this large, breezy 3rd floor corner unit offers super space, big windows, hardwood floors, a bright open kitchen and large, window-lined living room which opens to the private balcony. Spacious bedroom also opens to the balcony. Secure building & reserved parking. Included in rent is: Heat up to 55 degrees, hot water & reserved parking space #43. All popular attractions are a short stroll away. Property is currently being prepared for the new resident, and will be professionally cleaned after all work is finished.
